content: Ukochi na ndema
Bho, kukomana ngondu kuhuma kwako, na milomu jejibhi pachilanda jinu jihuma kwako? Bho, ngachejihuma, mu matokulelu ghinu mahakau ghaghaleta ngondu mu ihungu hinu?

Mtokulela namaa kupata hindu, wala ngachemuipata, mkoma na kubhona wihu, nambu ngamuwezi kuipata yela yemuipala, bhela mtenda kulochana na kukomana. Wala ngachempata yela yemuipala maghambu ngachemundobha Chapanga.
Kabhete pamlobha ngachemuipata maghambu ndobha kwa maholalelu mahakau; mlobha nahuli muitumila hindu heyi kwa matokulelu ghinu.
Mwenga bhagone! Bho, ngachemmanyi kubha nkochi na ndema nde kubha adui waka Chapanga? Henu kila joakubha nkochi wa ndema alitenda kubha adui waka Chapanga.
Bho, muholale kubha Malembu Mahuhu ghapwagha waka paghakapwaghiki: “Roho hoju ambaju Chapanga ambekiki mkati jitu abhi na wihu nakanopi?”
Nambu chihomu chetupekewa na Chapanga chibhi na makili nakanopi, ngati moghapwaghi Malembu Mahuhu: “Chapanga abhapenga bhabhalibhona, nambu abhapekeha chihomu bhabhaliheleha.”
Bhela mulihelia pahi jaka Chapanga. Mumpengaje Shetani, najombi anaantilaje.
Munheghalya Chapanga, najombi anahika pambipi na mwenga. Ngolulaje mabhoku ghinu, mwenga mwembi na mahoku! Ngolulaje mitima jinu, mwenga mwembi akandumila kubhele!
Mbonaje huzuni, mulelaje na kuombuleza. Chiheku chinu na chibya chilelu, na chiheku chinu chibya huzuni ngolongwa!
Muliheliyaje palongi jaka Bambo, najombi anaankwehaje.
Lilakalilu kubhokana na kubhatemu bhange

Bhalongo ngamwipwaghanila mahakau mabhete kwa mabhete. Mundu jokapi joampwagha mahakau njaki au kuntemula, mundu hoju ajikopungane Shelia na kujitemula. Nambu paujitemu Shelia, bhela ngachewitii Shelia, nambu ujitemu Shelia.
Chapanga kanjika jaki nde joabhekiki Shelia na kujitemula. Nde jombi kanjika jaki pela joaweza kukengalela na kuyonanga. Henu bho, wehapa nde wa nani mbaka untemu mundu jonge?
Lilakalilu kubhokana na kulibhona
Henu njowanyaje mwenga mwempwagha: “Lalenu au chilabhu anatujendaje ku muchi agho au ghola tukatamaje monihomu chaka chimu, tuhemalaje na kulombesa na kupata nyonjeka.”
Nambu ngachemmanyi hata matamu ghinu kwa chilabhu anaghabya bhole! Bho, womi winu nde kiki? Mwehapa nde ngati likongobha lelipitalila kwa chikahi chijipi pena na kuhobha kabhete.
Nambu impalika kupwagha: “Ngati Bambo anapaliki, anatutamaje na kuhenga chenjenu au chela.”
Nambu sajenu mulibhona na kulilumbalila. Kulibhona kwa ntundu ghonihoghu nde uhakau.
Bhela, mundu jokapi joamanyi lijambu lamboni lelumpalika kulihenga, nambu ngachealihenga, mundu jonihoju atenda mahoku.
